caption: The drawing depicts a metal candelabrum with four candle holders arranged at equal distances on a flat base. Each candle holder is cylindrical and sits atop a circular plate at the ends of horizontal rods that form a cross shape at the base. Four vertical, curved rods extend upward and inward from the base, converging near the center, and each rod is decorated with a spiral curl near its base. A single, twisted central rod rises vertically from the convergence point and ends in a hook with a small curl at the tip. The object is rendered in shades of gray and black on a beige background, suggesting it is drawn with pencil or graphite on light-colored paper. There are no other objects or elements in the drawing, and the overall composition is centered, with the candelabrum taking up most of the space. Handwritten text is present in the bottom right corner, reading "Jack Staloff and Jacob Lipkin."
title: Chandelier
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
